notes: BMCHook (src/BMCHook.sol) is the hook of the BMC/ETH pool. Constructor, in declaration order: IPoolManager _poolManager ($poolManager), address _token ($token, the BMCToken the factory deploys just before the hook), address _feeRecipient (the community wallet the brief names, 0x83027ad9d0d5374335086c539dadd1db983441b0, which is also the launch owner), uint256 _buyFeeBps (100 = 1%), uint256 _sellBurnBps (100 = 1%). All five are immutable; the hook has no owner, no setters, no pause and no upgrade path. The constructor rejects zero addresses and rates above 50%. On every swap in its pool: a buy (ETH in, BMC out) pays an extra 1% of the ETH side to _feeRecipient as native ETH inside the same swap; a sell (BMC in, ETH out) has 1% of the BMC sold taken and burned with the token's burn(), which lowers totalSupply. Exact-input swaps are charged in beforeSwap off the specified input (beforeSwapReturnDelta); exact-output swaps are charged in afterSwap on the unspecified input (afterSwapReturnDelta). When the PoolManager's balance cannot cover a fee at trade time (a pool seeded with tokens only holds no ETH before the first buy settles) the hook mints itself an ERC-6909 claim instead of reverting, and collect(), callable by anyone, redeems claims: ETH to the recipient, BMC burned. Swaps are never blocked or altered otherwise; liquidity and donate callbacks are not enabled and revert if ever reached. getHookPermissions returns exactly beforeInitialize, beforeSwap, afterSwap, beforeSwapReturnDelta and afterSwapReturnDelta (address bits 0x20CC); BMCHook.HOOK_FLAGS exposes the same value. beforeInitialize accepts calls only from the PoolManager and exactly one pool: currency0 native ETH, currency1 the launch token, at any LP fee and tick spacing, from any initializer, so the factory's initialize at fee 12500 and spacing 60 is accepted; a second pool, a pool without the token, or a non-ETH pair is refused. Every callback and unlockCallback refuse any caller but the PoolManager. BMCToken (src/BMCToken.sol) is a plain OpenZeppelin ERC20 + ERC20Burnable: BMC Illuminati / BMC, 18 decimals, no constructor arguments, the whole supply minted once to its deployer (the factory); no owner, mint, pause, limits or transfer fees; burn/burnFrom act on the caller's own balance or allowance only. pool.fee 12500 is the launch policy's LP fee (1% to the launcher, 0.25% to IMD), on top of which the hook's 1% buy fee and 1% sell burn apply. The community wallet is expected to be an EOA: a contract recipient that rejects ETH would revert direct-pay buys and could not be paid by collect() either, and the address is immutable. Foundry tests in test/ verify the buy fee transfer, the sell burn, the claim path on a token-only seeded manager, caller checks and the permission/flag agreement. pool.initialPrice is the launch's fixed manifest value (2^96, one to one) and is not the opening price: the deployer derives the opening sqrtPriceX96 from the policy's 10 ETH market cap for the whole supply and from which currency sorts first once the token address is known; the tests open their local pool at the 10 ETH-cap price (OPENING_SQRT_PRICE in test/utils/BMCFixture.sol) for the ETH-first ordering the hook requires.
